note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PS5 list as published 18 Nov 2026 (Exophase via Push Square; GTABase, PowerPyx, GTA Zone, Output Lag and EGamers all report the same 55). Every guide below is written in our own words for this entry and names its sources beside it; nothing is copied from another guide. Five trophies had no confirmed unlock method at launch (Output Lag / GTA Zone) and their guides say so plainly instead of inventing a method.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — there is no separate task. Work the roadmap in order: story first, the one missable meditation trophy during Chapter 1, then collectibles, activities and the money cleanup, finishing with 100% completion. PowerPyx rates the whole run at about 200 hours and 4/10 difficulty.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks in the opening minutes and cannot be missed — just play the story.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. A story trophy — it pops when the chapter's final mission ends. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter: guides report no mission replay, so a save is your only way back for anything chapter-limited.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (no mission replay; save per chapter)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. A story trophy, unmissable. Most of the free-roam list opens once Jason and Lucia are both playable in this chapter, so start side activities here.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. A story trophy, unmissable. Robbery trophies start unlocking in Chapters 3 and 4, so expect the heist-style trophies to open up around here.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. A story trophy, unmissable — the last numbered chapter before the finale.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. A story trophy, unmissable, and the last story beat before the post-game cleanup. Make a manual save before the final mission — guides report no mission replay.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (no mission replay)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The in-game checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) appears after the story, but progress made earlier counts and nothing on it is missable. PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of true completion — finish the story first, then work the checklist. It is the hardest trophy on the list and the last step before the Platinum.

sources.name: GTA Zone — Trophy List (PowerPyx: 100% checklist, ~60% of true completion)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the jump and airtime feats the game counts — chain them during free roam and while travelling between objectives. The count is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so it builds up on its own if you drive fast and take every jump.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Play one round of every activity the game offers — races, fishing, arcade games, the shooting range, drone races and the rest — and the trophy pops when the last type is tried. It is a sampler, not a mastery test: one try each is enough.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through every range challenge and hit the gold score on each — 42 golds is the full set. Practice the weapon types you are weakest with first; gold is a score bar, not a one-shot pass.

sources.name: U7BUY — GTA 6 Trophies (42 shooting-range gold medals)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Find each drone-race location, win one race at each, and the trophy pops when the last location is won. Races are repeatable, so a lost race costs nothing but a retry.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Win twenty races across different race types and locations — variety is the requirement, not twenty wins in one event. Mix race types as you find them and the count climbs.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and out-fish him. Fishing is one of the game's activities — learn the casting and reeling rhythm in a practice session first, then take the challenge.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade cabinet through to the end of a game — one completion is enough. Arcades sit in the game's entertainment spots; pick the shortest game on your first visit.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of the strangers with a mission strand — play his strand through to its last mission. Stranger strands are free-roam side content, available once you meet him.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's stranger strand, played through to its last mission — meet him in free roam and follow his strand to the end.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's stranger strand, played through to its last mission — meet him in free roam and follow his strand to the end.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Find eight different strangers and finish each one's strand. The five named stranger finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of the eight — find three more strangers in the open world.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's stranger strand, played through to its last mission — meet him in free roam and follow his strand to the end.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, as Jason and Lucia. THIS IS THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY: GTABase and PowerPyx flag it as the only possibly missable trophy, because Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter, and there is no mission replay. Meditate at every spot you find, starting in Chapter 1, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand asks for one specific animal — track it in the wild and take it down. Hunting is a Leonida activity; follow Bret's strand to learn which animal and where it roams.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find the collectible cards scattered across Leonida and complete three full sets. Cards are a pure collectible — sweep each area methodically and use the in-game markers once they appear.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Find and interact with 100 WAiNK spots across Leonida — a count collectible, so it is a slow sweep of the map rather than a single challenge. Tick locations off as you travel so none gets missed.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Work through the game's challenge list until 50 are done — challenges span driving, combat, exploration and activities, so they accumulate across normal play. Check the challenge list regularly to see which are close.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and escape until the stars clear. It needs both of you in the escape — do it with your partner beside you.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole way — plan a route with three close shops, rob fast, and do not let the heat drop between them.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Find and enter 100 different vehicles — the count is discoveries, not purchases, so hop into every new vehicle you see. It builds up across the whole game if you vary your rides.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus with at least five enemies in range and drop all five before it ends. Pick a busy fight, wait until enemies cluster, then trigger it.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Get to Vice City International Airport and leave by an unscheduled route — the description points at taking off without a scheduled flight. Expect it to draw airport security, so be ready to run.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Get into a Rhino tank and cause chaos with it — the trophy's joke title points at the tank itself. Military hardware is guarded, so expect a fight to reach one.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan the robbery, get in and out without raising the alarm — stealth is the requirement, so avoid cameras and guards rather than fighting through them.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit five bank vaults and escape clean after each. Vaults are the bigger robberies — bring your partner and a getaway plan for each one.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck, take it, and escape. Trucks run set routes — watch for one, block it, and have an escape vehicle ready.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Cover the whole map — every region of Leonida counts. It is a pure exploration trophy: drive, fly and walk the map until every area is revealed.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Hit one illegal operation for every gang in Leonida. Learn which gang runs which operation and work through them one by one.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Have a drink at a spot overlooking Ocean Beach. NOTE — no confirmed unlock method has been published at launch: Output Lag and GTA Zone list this among the five trophies with no confirmed method, so the description is the whole lead. Try the beachfront bars on Ocean Beach and check back as the community pins it down.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Break out of a vehicle showroom by driving through it. NOTE — no confirmed unlock method at launch: the description suggests a showroom smash, but no guide has pinned down which showroom or the exact trigger yet.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (no confirmed unlock method at launch)
GTA Zone — Trophy List (five unconfirmed entries)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowl at the Kolt & Associates alley — the trophy is about the follow-through, so finish a game there. Bowling is one of the game's activities.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Build your partnership's standing until it hits the mark the trophy wants — the description is vague, so treat it as a relationship trophy tied to playing together with your partner. Do partner activities, robberies and free-roam time together and it should come.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Make a story choice and live with it — the trophy pops on a decision point in the story. Choices are part of the story, so it unlocks as you play; if you want to see the other branch, that is what the manual chapter saves are for.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (save per chapter)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something once, then succeed on the second try — the trophy reads like a retry reward. NOTE — no confirmed unlock method at launch: Output Lag and GTA Zone list this among the five trophies with no confirmed method, so the description is the whole lead.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (no confirmed unlock method at launch)
GTA Zone — Trophy List (five unconfirmed entries)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Trigger one of the game's strange one-off events — the description reads like a surprise encounter. NOTE — no confirmed unlock method at launch: no guide has pinned down the event yet, so treat this as one to watch for while exploring.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (no confirmed unlock method at launch)
GTA Zone — Trophy List (five unconfirmed entries)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock the pins over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. NOTE — no confirmed unlock method at launch: the description suggests a bowling and melee-drive-by combo, but the exact spot and setup are not yet confirmed.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (no confirmed unlock method at launch)
GTA Zone — Trophy List (five unconfirmed entries)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder Marked Bills through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. Marked Bills come from robberies — keep laundering as you earn them and the total builds up.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in total across the game's shops — weapons, clothes, vehicles and the rest all count. It accumulates across the whole playthrough, so it pops on its own if you buy freely.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property on the market. Garages are bought with in-game money — save up and buy them as they appear.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten vehicles you own to the Scooter Bros app — the game's vehicle service. Own ten vehicles, open the app, and register each one.
